summary.text: Kevin Martin is an accounting and finance professional with more than 35 years of experience, including 25 as a controller, and the Republican nominee for Georgia's 6th Congressional District. He describes himself as a fifth-generation native Atlantan who lives in Smyrna, and is campaigning on youth education programs, elder care costs, and controlled growth in the district.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Martin is a fifth-generation native Atlantan who was born in Smyrna, Georgia, and still lives there.
He graduated from Campbell High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the Georgia Institute of Technology in 1989, and later earned a bachelor's degree from Georgia State University in 1998.

He says he has worked in accounting and finance for over 35 years, the last 25 as a controller, across the banking, legal, service, heavy equipment distribution, and building-material and food manufacturing industries.
Martin describes leadership and mentoring roles with youth, young adults, and employees.
He won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for the 6th District over Justin Pinker, 70.1% to 29.9%.
